connect.acc.reorder: Reorder {name}. Drag, or press the up and down arrow keys
connect.acc.pinned_note: Uses only {name}. At a limit it doesn't switch accounts; if the fallback order has another step (API keys included), it continues there. Reply drafts never switch to an API key, so they pause until the limit clears.
connect.limit.switch_sub: At a limit it switches automatically
connect.limit.wait_done: Set to wait at a limit
connect.limit.switch_done: Set to switch automatically at a limit
connect.rules.title: Switch rules
connect.rules.none: Switches automatically only when an account is blocked.
connect.limit.title: At a limit
connect.acc.none_add: Add one and it shows up here.
connect.acc.none_login: Sign in or add an API key.
connect.acc.delete_body: This removes the account's sign-in from OmO. To use it again, sign in again.
connect.rules.name: Rule name
connect.dev.title: Connected devices
connect.dev.add_passkey: Add a passkey to this device
connect.dev.no_passkey: This browser came in without a passkey
connect.dev.sec: Devices that can use this web app
connect.dev.name: Device name
connect.dev.remove_self: This device is signed out right away. To use it again, connect it with a code sent to your messenger.
connect.dev.remove_other: {name} is signed out right away. To use it again, connect it with a new code.
connect.dev.qr: QR code to connect a new device
connect.dev.step_self: Tap 'Open connect page', then enter the code and a name for this device.
connect.dev.step_passkey: Confirm with a passkey (Face ID, fingerprint, Windows Hello and the like) and you're done.
connect.dev.step_open: Open this web app's address in the new device's browser. The 'Connect device' page appears.
connect.dev.step_qr: Scan the QR code or enter the code above.
connect.dev.step_name: Enter a device name and confirm with a passkey (Face ID, fingerprint, Windows Hello and the like), and you're done.
connect.dev.code_note: A code works once within 10 minutes. You can make up to 3 an hour, counting your messenger and this screen together.
connect.dc.kind_chat_sub: Replies in chats you didn't start on Discord
connect.dc.kind_lanes_sub: Progress and completion reports from sessions
connect.dc.kind_web_sub: Sessions started on the web or in a terminal get a Discord channel too
connect.dc.token_delete_body: This deletes the saved bot token. Discord disconnects when dotz restarts.
connect.restart_later: Restarts when work finishes. This screen reconnects on its own
connect.dc.half: The token is saved. Save the server ID and your user ID too, then restart the gateway to connect.
connect.dc.not_yet: No Discord bot is connected yet.
connect.dc.direct_note: Replies to what you ask on Discord go to Discord too.
connect.dc.per_chat: Also send to Discord, per chat
connect.dc.token_saved: Bot token (saved · paste a new one to change)
connect.dc.how1: In the Discord Developer Portal (discord.com/developers), create a new app, turn on MESSAGE CONTENT in the Bot tab, and copy the bot token
connect.dc.how2: Invite the bot to your server with the invite link (save above, then tap Check connection to get the link)
connect.dc.how3: Paste the bot token, server ID and your user ID under “Enter manually” and save
connect.ms.title: Messengers
connect.ms.tap_connect: Tap Connect and it's set up automatically.
connect.ms.tap_on: It's set up. Tap Turn on to send alerts.
connect.ms.test_failed: Couldn't check · {error}. Try again in a moment
connect.paste_new: Paste a new one to change
connect.onb.waiting: One step is left for you.
connect.onb.start_failed: Couldn't start connecting · {error}. Try again in a moment
connect.onb.title: Automatic setup
connect.wa.tailscale_sub: Opens on your devices connected through Tailscale. This is the default.
connect.wa.cloudflare_sub: Opens a fixed address through a Cloudflare tunnel. Setup runs automatically and tells you the one thing you need to do.
connect.wa.title: Web access
connect.wa.no_tunnel_hint: The tunnel program is missing. In chat, say “install web access”.
connect.wa.host_help: The address attached to the tunnel. If you change it, devices must be connected again.
connect.wa.team_help: Only for a second check with Cloudflare Access. Fill it in together with the audience tag.
connect.wa.aud_help: The Audience Tag shown on the Access app's page.
connect.wa.token_help: Once saved, it stays on this computer only and is never shown again.
connect.wa.devices_sub: Browsers that can open this web app
connect.wa.plain_note: Cloudflare can read what passes through it in plain text, because the encryption (TLS) ends there.
connect.rt.no_adapter: dotz doesn't support it yet, so you can't switch.
connect.rt.blocked: Core checks didn't pass, so you can't switch: {list}
connect.rt.stale: The version changed after the check (v{from} → v{to}). Run the check again.

connect.rt.adjusted.one: All core checks passed. {n} feature is handled by the gateway or turned off.
connect.rt.adjusted.other: All core checks passed. {n} features are handled by the gateway or turned off.

connect.rt.omo_note: OmO is the default runtime, so it needs no check.
connect.rt.check_note: It's checked before the switch. The check runs a short real task, so it can take a minute or two.
connect.rt.no_adapter_check: dotz doesn't support it yet, so you can't switch. Run the check to see which items are blocked.
connect.rt.omp_note: omp is an optional runtime. It was the original one, so you can switch without a check.
